effect_description_eng: [Main] 1 of your Digimon with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] trait can attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying its memory cost. Then, add this card to your hand.
